The cause of the protector of the three realms. Pi pi ling ga ga rjes la gi.
Establish the dwelling of sentient beings with molten metal.
In the place of the form and hand, of the harmonious and disharmonious, of the auspicious and inauspicious,
May the deities protect me, may they guard me!
Oṃ trag tu tre ye svāhā. Oṃ tre'u bzlog. Oṃ trag rakṣa bzlog. Oṃ ma ma gyi ta bzlog. Oṃ ma surya bzlog.
Oṃ a candra ye svāhā. Oṃ pu pa ra ta ye svāhā. Oṃ pri ti sha ti svāhā.
Oṃ ma ma sngo ta sngo ta ye svāhā. Oṃ ma ma raṃ raṃ ye svāhā.
Oṃ ma ma kar kar ye svāhā. Oṃ ma ma char chur yar yer svāhā.
Oṃ ma ma su su taṃ taṃ ye svāhā.

Ā yu ra yu te a kur zhi ha le. Sa su tri phaṭ. Oṃ oṃ hūṃ ke raṃ te phaṭ. Dha dha na ma sa ra ma sa te. Da ha na na hūṃ hūṃ zhi zhi mal mal zhag po zhi. Pur he ni ha ha na sāhā. Zhi dha lam du sa se phaṭ. Me a rakṣa si ma du ye. Nag po zhi sa ma ye a na phaṭ. Gu ma gu te nag po zhi. Oṃ hūṃ sarva rakṣa hūṃ. Dha dha na dha ho. Me he ma ho rakṣa rbad. Zhi zhi dul dul svāhā. Lhan. Oṃ namo buddhāya. Namo dharmāya. Namo saṃghāya. A ne na te. Tadyathā. A ka ra na sad. Svabha sa pra dharma ni sa. Sarva tathā. Oṃ shodha bi pu sha. Bi ma le tsa le. Ru lu ru lu. translation: Cause of the protector of the three realms, pi pi ling ga ga rjes la gi, establish the molten-metal benefit for the abode of human beings.
